messages:
ella: Heads-up — PR #7839 fixes a kv-cache shard pinning bug that shows up in microbatch runs. Need one more approval to merge and then run an extended canary. Posting quick bench + logs below. https://git.redwood/pr/7839

bench-bot: Quick bench output (canary short):
```
bench: canary-small
model: redwood-llama-13b
seq: 8192
workers: 4
before: mem rss avg 11.2GB
after: mem rss avg 13.1GB (+16.9%)
p50 latency 48ms -> 52ms (+8%)
p95 latency 210ms -> 235ms (+12%)
throughput tokens/s 2400 -> 2350 (-2%)
```

matt: Did you run with kv-sharding enabled? That looks like shard growth rather than true leak.

ella: Yes, kv-sharding on. Root cause was an early-exit path that left per-shard maps pinned. The PR frees maps after evict and adds a defensive check.

priyanka: Can you paste an alloc profile or flamegraph?

ella: Added a pprof snippet in the PR and attached a small flamegraph. Relevant extract:
```
# pprof top (alloc_space)
8.1GB  62.0% 62.0%  runtime.mcache_spanalloc
2.0GB  15.3% 77.3%  github.com/redwood/inference/kv.(*shard).reserve
1.2GB   9.2% 86.5%  github.com/redwood/inference/kv.(*cache).put
```

tobias: I can review but please add a minimal repro that triggers the growth (script or job).

ella: Done — added repro script to pr and a bench job link. Kicking off extended canary (30m) now.

sam: Left a small nit on the locking comment, otherwise looks fine. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary pipeline started — job/CI #9382

bench-bot: Extended canary (30m) finished: mem peak reduced vs short-run. Summary: mem delta now +4% at 1h, p95 +10%. Raw CSV attached to PR.

matt: If the extended canary stabilized, I'm fine approving. @tobias ?

tobias: LGTM pending one more run at seq=16384 (16k) to ensure no scale regressions. Can we schedule that?

ella: Kicking off 16k run now (will take ~45m). Will ping when done.

bench-bot: 16k run complete:
```
seq: 16384
mem rss avg before: 22.8GB
mem rss avg after: 23.5GB (+3.1%)
p50 latency 112ms -> 120ms (+7%)
p95 latency 560ms -> 609ms (+8.7%)
throughput tokens/s 1200 -> 1180 (-1.7%)
```

bench-bot: Extended notes: allocations now free on evict, GC stabilizes footprint within 10-15 minutes. No unbounded growth observed.

tobias: :thumbsup: approving now.

ella: Thanks all — merging after approvals and will monitor canary rollout.
